projectDescription: A Django REST Framework backend for the ARES rescue robot system, exposing REST APIs to manage rescue robots, their sensors, and real-time sensor readings.
keyFeatures: Robot fleet management with location tracking (latitude/longitude) and status monitoring
Sensor registry linking sensors (type and unit) to specific robots
Continuous sensor readings ingestion with processing state tracking
Full CRUD REST API powered by Django REST Framework ViewSets
Auto-generated browsable API and router-based URL configuration
SQLite-backed data persistence with Django ORM migrations
publicApiSurface: POST /api/robots/ — Register a new rescue robot
GET /api/robots/{id}/ — Retrieve a robot by ID
GET /api/sensores/{id}/ — Retrieve a sensor by ID
POST /api/lecturas/ — Submit a new sensor reading
GET /api/lecturas/{id}/ — Retrieve a reading by ID
